oracle.note: Every case's oracle output below was produced by running the pinned released y0 package on the documented graph and event in a temporary environment that was deleted after import: this version of y0, with these inputs, produced this output. y0's id_star returns a functional of interventional distributions (identification from all experiments); the harness also ran y0's identify_outcomes (ID from the observational law) on every interventional term it returned. The parity test parses each verbatim output, classifies it (conflict, zero, or an expression whose every term ID identifies) and compares it with Antecedent's decision on the same graph; disagreements are recorded with their reason, never bent.

generation.env: uv venv <tmp>/y0env --python 3.11 && VIRTUAL_ENV=<tmp>/y0env uv pip install y0 && <tmp>/y0env/bin/python y0_harness.py
generation.script_note: The harness was deleted after the import, per convention. Its sha256 is provenance only; the parity test reads the recorded verbatim output rather than re-running the oracle.

reference.runtime: CPython 3.11.5; networkx 3.6.1, numpy 2.4.6, pandas 3.0.6, scipy 1.17.1, statsmodels 0.15.0
reference.command: python y0_harness.py (id_star on {Y @ -X: -Y, X: +X}; identify_outcomes on every interventional term)
reference.note: black-box execution of y0.algorithm.identify.id_star.id_star and y0.algorithm.identify.identify_outcomes only; source and tests are not copied. Values use y0's star notation: -V is the unstarred level v, +V the starred level v'; the event {Y @ -X: -Y, X: +X} is P(Y_x = y, X = x').

oracle.graph_set: 5 named fixtures; every 3-node ADMG under the order V0 < V1 < V2 (8 directed x 8 bidirected edge sets) with each forward (treatment, outcome) pair; 60 seeded (Python random 2208) 4-node ADMGs with the treatment reaching the outcome.

disagreement_note: y0 0.2.11 returns Zero() for these 20 graphs; Antecedent refuses each with a checked conflicting-subscript obstruction (route_not_supported / counterfactual_id.conflicting_subscripts: ID* does not identify the conjunction, which is not a proof of non-identifiability). Zero is wrong: the parity test builds a latent structural model on each graph whose event P(Y_x = y, X = x') has positive probability, and for the instrument graph an explicit two-model witness (tests/counterfactual_id_search.rs) shows the ETT is not identified. The zero is consistent with y0 representing every value by one of two symbols (-V and +V), so a summation variable left free is given the unstarred value and later merged with a starred observation of the same variable as an inconsistency; the cause is inferred from the source, not verified. The other 237 cases agree on the verdict: 171 identified by both (y0's expression, every interventional term identified by identify_outcomes) and 66 refused by both (ConflictUnidentifiable). On the 171, y0's recorded expression is also parsed and evaluated on a random latent model's joint and equals Antecedent's numerator and the enumerated truth (1e-10). Antecedent's binary-treatment consistency complement (tried after an ID* refusal) answers none of these 257 graphs, so it adds no disagreement.
